description.value: Hot House Pizza is a Victoria-based pizza chain with several locations across the city, offering hand-made crusts, fresh-made sauce, and a wide range of specialty and build-your-own pizzas. The Victoria West location caters to takeout and delivery customers, with slices available to-go — a quick refuelling option for cyclists passing through the Vic West neighbourhood. Dietary accommodations include gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan cheese options.
